description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Marker_Value', a specialized marker for displaying data values in a graph, including methods for setting styles, preprocessing data, and rendering the marker.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Value
classes.description: A marker showing the data value, capable of customizing display and style, used within the Image_Graph package.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Value
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the marker with a specified data value type (X or Y).

methods.name: setBackground
methods.description: Sets the background fill style of the marker.

methods.name: setBackgroundColor
methods.description: Sets the background color of the marker.

methods.name: setDataPreprocessor
methods.description: Assigns a data preprocessor to format the displayed value.

methods.name: _getDisplayValue
methods.description: Retrieves the appropriate data value to display based on the configured type.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Handles rendering the marker and its value on the canvas at specified coordinates.
